result.markdown: --- title: "Psychometrics with the IRW: course map" --- ::: {.cell} ::: These are stand-alone lessons on psychometrics, each built around open data from the [Item Response Warehouse](https://itemresponsewarehouse.org). You can teach them in sequence as a full course or pick out individual lessons. The core lessons make a first course in psychometrics; lessons marked optional go further. Each lesson lists what it assumes and what builds on it. The lessons grew out of EDUC 252 (Introduction to Psychometrics) at Stanford. ::: {.callout-warning appearance="simple"} **Work in progress.** The lesson list and prerequisites are a first draft, and most lessons are still stubs. ::: ## Lessons by module ```{=html} ``` ::: {.module-grid} ::: {.module-card} ### Foundations 1.
